title: Demonstrator
summary: DEMONSTRATOR, noun 1. One who demonstrates; one who proves any thing with certainty, or with indubitable evidence. 2. In anatomy, one who exhibits the parts when dissected.

inlines.v: DEMONSTRATOR, noun 1. One who demonstrates; one who proves any thing with certainty, or with indubitable evidence. 2. In anatomy, one who exhibits the parts when dissected.
